findings.title: Bling webhook accepts unsigned POSTs even when webhook secrets are configured
findings.controlled_input: POST /api/portal/bling/webhook with forged product/stock JSON and no X-Bling-Signature-256 header
findings.attack_path: Handler verifies HMAC only when both secrets and signature header exist (lines 128-135). When secrets are configured but the header is missing, it logs missing_signature_header_accepted and continues processing with createSupabaseServiceClient and processBlingWebhook.
findings.impact: Cross-tenant catalog and stock mutation via service role for the resolved organization
findings.remediation: Return 401 when secrets are configured and the signature header is missing or invalid

findings.title: Bling webhook resolves organization to most recently updated tenant when companyId is absent or unmatched
findings.attacker: Any unauthenticated internet actor (often combined with unsigned webhook acceptance)
findings.controlled_input: Webhook payload without companyId/idEmpresa or with a value not present in hub_connections metadata
findings.attack_path: resolveOrganizationId falls back to hub_connections for platform bling ordered by updated_at desc limit 1 when companyId is missing or unmatched (lines 83-91).
findings.impact: Legitimate or forged Bling events mutate products/stock of the wrong organization in multi-tenant deployments
findings.remediation: Require resolvable companyId and reject when no exact hub_connections match; remove global fallback

findings.title: allocate_fiscal_document_number SECURITY DEFINER RPC is callable cross-organization by any authenticated user
findings.attacker: Any authenticated Supabase session via browser or direct PostgREST RPC
findings.controlled_input: supabase.rpc allocate_fiscal_document_number with victim organization UUID, model 65 or 55, and environment producao or homologacao
findings.attack_path: Function runs SECURITY DEFINER with row_security off, updates organization_fiscal_profiles counters for arbitrary p_organization_id, granted to authenticated without membership check.
findings.impact: Consumes or desynchronizes NFC-e/NFe numbering for victim organizations; fiscal emission failures or duplicate-number risk
findings.remediation: Revoke authenticated grant; enforce membership/admin check inside function or restrict to service_role only

findings.title: admin_storage_usage_summary SECURITY DEFINER RPC exposes cross-tenant storage metrics to any authenticated user
findings.attacker: Any authenticated Supabase session bypassing Next.js requireAdmin route guard
findings.controlled_input: supabase.rpc admin_storage_usage_summary with victim organization UUID
findings.attack_path: SECURITY DEFINER SQL reads storage.objects project-wide and aggregates org-scoped categories for supplied UUID without admin or membership checks; granted to authenticated.
findings.impact: Cross-tenant storage usage intelligence leak plus project-wide bucket totals exposed to non-admin users
findings.remediation: Revoke authenticated grant or add is_admin/membership guard; keep callable only from service role or admin-checked API

findings.title: WhatsApp Cloud webhook skips HMAC verification when WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET is unset
findings.attacker: Any unauthenticated internet actor when deployment omits app secret env var
findings.controlled_input: Unsigned POST with forged Meta webhook JSON targeting a known phone_number_id
findings.attack_path: Signature block runs only if appSecret is truthy (lines 75-79); otherwise payload is parsed and processWhatsappWebhookPayload runs with service client.
findings.impact: Forged inbound messages trigger automation, persist conversations, and can drive outbound replies for matched organization
findings.remediation: Fail closed when app secret is missing in production; never process unsigned POST bodies

findings.title: Evolution API webhook accepts unauthenticated POSTs when WHATSAPP_EVOLUTION_WEBHOOK_SECRET is unset
findings.attacker: Any unauthenticated internet actor when webhook secret env var is empty
findings.controlled_input: POST with JSON containing a known or guessable Evolution instance name
findings.attack_path: Secret header check wrapped in if (secret) (lines 28-40); empty secret skips auth and processEvolutionWebhookPayload executes.
findings.impact: Injected messages and delivery-state events for the organization owning that Evolution instance
findings.remediation: Require configured secret and reject requests when unset

findings.title: OS share-link customer registration creates email-confirmed auth users without proving email ownership
findings.attacker: Anyone possessing a valid OS share_token and org slug from a leaked customer link
findings.controlled_input: registerCustomerFromOsLinkAction with victim email and attacker-chosen password
findings.attack_path: After share_token/org validation only, svc.auth.admin.createUser sets email_confirm true without verification; creates organization_members row via service role.
findings.impact: Pre-registers and confirms arbitrary emails, blocking legitimate signup and granting portal membership in target org
findings.remediation: Use email verification flow or bind registration to customer document already on the OS before confirming account

findings.title: Authenticated users can join an organization via leaked OS share link without proving customer identity
findings.attacker: Any authenticated user who obtains ref_os share token and org slug
findings.attack_path: Page validates share_token and slug only, then upserts organization_members with role user and may set customers.auth_user_id when empty.
findings.impact: Unauthorized portal access to victim organization and hijack of unlinked customer records
findings.remediation: Require CPF/CNPJ match to OS customer or one-time signed token bound to intended recipient before membership upsert

findings.title: claim_customer_by_cpf links existing customer records to attacker without proving CPF ownership
findings.attacker: Any authenticated user via POST /api/portal/complete-profile or direct Supabase RPC
findings.controlled_input: cpf_input matching an existing customers row with auth_user_id null
findings.attack_path: SECURITY DEFINER claim_customer_by_cpf sets customers.auth_user_id to auth.uid(), inserts organization_members for the customer organization, and updates user_portal_context without OTP, document check, or email verification.
findings.impact: Account takeover of unlinked customer records and unauthorized portal access to the victim retailer organization when attacker knows the victim CPF
findings.remediation: Require identity proof before linking auth_user_id; rate-limit claims; notify retailer on CPF claim attempts

findings.title: Public organization registration confirms arbitrary emails without verification
findings.controlled_input: POST /api/public/register-organization with victim email and attacker-chosen password
findings.attack_path: registerOrganization calls svc.auth.admin.createUser with email_confirm true, then creates organization, admin membership, and portal context via service role without sending verification email.
findings.impact: Email pre-registration and admin org squatting blocks legitimate signup for the victim address
findings.remediation: Use Supabase email verification before email_confirm; add CAPTCHA and rate limits on the public endpoint
